fields.label: Operating Rate Lookback (days)
fields.description: Number of days for the operating rate weighted moving average. Minimum 30.

fields.label: Operating Rate Half-Life (days)
fields.description: Half-life in days for the exponential time-decay weighting. Lower = more weight on recent days.

fields.label: Capital Rate Lookback (days)
fields.description: Fixed 365-day lookback for depreciation-based capital rate.

fields.label: Operating P&L Accounts
fields.description: Comma-separated P&L account numbers for operating expenses (e.g., 5200, 5300, 5400). Exclude depreciation and maintenance/repair accounts.

fields.label: Depreciation P&L Accounts
fields.description: Comma-separated P&L account numbers for depreciation (e.g., 5400). Used for capital rate calculation.

fields.label: Default Target Margin (%)
fields.description: Default margin percentage applied to selling price in the grower price formula.

fields.label: Item Group
fields.description: Only items in this group are included in the kg denominator for base rate calculation.

fields.label: UOM
fields.description: Only items with this UOM are included in the kg denominator for base rate calculation.

fields.label: Max Operating Rate (€/kg)
fields.description: Flag if operating rate exceeds this value. Indicates possible data error or low-volume period.

fields.label: Min Operating Rate (€/kg)
fields.description: Flag if operating rate falls below this value. Indicates missing GL data or misconfigured accounts.

fields.label: Rate Stability Threshold (%)
fields.description: Max allowed month-over-month deviation before flagging for manual review. Set to 0 to disable.

fields.label: Reconciliation Variance Threshold (%)
fields.description: Max allowed variance between imputed (rate x kg) and actual P&L totals before flagging.

fields.options:
The following variables can be used in Subject and Message templates. They will be replaced with actual values when the reminder is sent.

  • {{ invoice_name }} — Sales Invoice number
  • {{ customer_name }} — Customer name
  • {{ due_date }} — Invoice due date
  • {{ posting_date }} — Invoice posting date
  • {{ total }} — Invoice total amount
  • {{ outstanding_amount }} — Outstanding balance
  • {{ days_overdue }} — Number of days past due
  • {{ reminder_level }} — Reminder level (1-4)
  • {{ company }} — Company name
